hero.caption: The American torpedo boat PT-109 entering Tulagi carrying 94 survivors from the sunken heavy cruiser USS Northampton (CA-26) The previous night, during the battle of Tassafaronga, Northampton was hit by two torpedoes from the Japanese destroyers Kagerō and Makinami which sank her over 2 hours and 16 minutes. In the background, the crippled heavy cruiser USS New Orleans (CA-32) is seen in the background, having been hit by a torpedo from the destroyer Takanami which sheared off her bow and turret 1.

images.caption:
Photo #: 80-G-K-13927 (Color)
Lieutenant John D. Bulkeley, USN
Photographed circa Spring 1942, shortly before he was promoted to Lieutenant Commander and awarded the Medal of Honor for his actions while in command of Motor Torpedo Boat Squadron Three during the Philippines Campaign, December 1941-April 1942.

Official U.S. Navy Photograph, now in the collections of the National Archives.
